title: Bhima Singh and Lakhmir Singh Enter the Fight

blocks.text: Even though Takki Khan was completely covered with a steel armour, Tara Singh pierced the tip of his sword into his face and showed that fearlessness could reach what armour could not protect.

The taunt that followed mocked Tara Singh as though he were sitting there with the beetelnut packets, but the assault only drove the Singhs into a fiercer counterattack rather than shaking their nerve.

The page then celebrates Bhima Singh in a mood of chivalrous ecstasy, catching the elephant by the ear and cutting down its support while Tara Singh turns and begins addressing Lakhmir Singh for the next decisive stroke.
